finding_addressed.symptom: After submitting https://www.synthetic.example/detail-50000001.html the durable intake reached retryable FAILED with ODP-INTAKE-RETRIEVAL-TIMEOUT, and 展開保留輸入參數 (Preserved Input) rendered {} instead of the submitted URL.
finding_addressed.root_cause: IntakeProcessingDetail built preservedInput exclusively from record.parsedFields. Retrieval fails before parsing for this corpus entry (modules/external_data/application/assisted_intake.py returns a RetrievalFailure with no raw payload), so parsedFields is {} while the durable record still carries originalUrl, canonicalUrl, heatZoneId, sourceId and intakeMethod.
finding_addressed.design_requirement: docs/design/ODAY_PLUS_ASSISTED_LISTING_INTAKE_DESIGN_REQUIREMENTS.md section 7 — user-entered corrections and input must survive retryable failures.

IntakeProcessingDetail.tsx: Added exported buildPreservedInput(record) that reads the durable API-backed AssistedIntake record: originalUrl, canonicalUrl, heatZoneId, sourceId, intakeMethod.
Parsed/normalized/corrected field values are layered on top of that submission context so an operator correction still wins over normalized and source values.
Values the record does not supply (null, undefined, empty string) are omitted rather than filled with a placeholder; no business value is fabricated.
Server-masked parsed cells emit the same '•••• [MASKED]' marker EvidencePanel already renders.

A below-CONFIDENTIAL clearance receives originalUrl=null plus originalUrl_masked=true from modules/listing/application/intake_authorization.py; that case reports the masked marker so a withheld URL is not mistaken for an absent submission.
Returns null when the record supplies nothing at all.
IntakeErrorRecovery.tsx: The preserved-input drawer renders an explicit '保留輸入參數 UNAVAILABLE' marker (data-testid error-preserved-input-unavailable) instead of printing {} when nothing durable is available.
The JSON body carries data-testid error-preserved-input-json inside the existing error-preserved-input-box.
The existing purpose-binding redaction of token / password / secret / cred keys is unchanged.
remediation.no_shadow_state: No sessionStorage, localStorage, module-level cache, fixture, or component-local copy of the submission was added. The drawer is a pure projection of the record prop, so page reload and retry both re-read the durable API record.

acceptance_evidence.evidence: IntakeProcessingDetail.test.tsx 'preserves the durable submitted URL when retrieval fails before parsing' renders stage FAILED with parsedFields {} and the ODP-INTAKE-RETRIEVAL-TIMEOUT failure, opens the drawer, and asserts error-preserved-input-box contains https://www.synthetic.example/detail-50000001.html and is not '{}'.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: canonical URL and corrected values preserved when available
acceptance_evidence.evidence: IntakeProcessingDetail.test.tsx 'layers corrected field values over the durable submission context' asserts the corrected address wins over normalized/source and that originalUrl and canonicalUrl are both present; heatZoneId coverage is in the pre-parse test.

IntakeErrorRecovery.test.tsx 'redacts credential-class keys under purpose binding while keeping business values' asserts token / password / secret / credential values are replaced by [REDACTED_PURPOSE_BINDING] while the URL and address values survive.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: missing values absent or explicitly unavailable, nothing fabricated
acceptance_evidence.evidence: IntakeProcessingDetail.test.tsx 'builds preserved input only from values the intake record supplies' asserts empty/null record fields are omitted, an all-empty record yields null, a masked parsed cell yields '•••• [MASKED]', and a flagged withheld originalUrl yields the masked marker. IntakeErrorRecovery.test.tsx 'declares preserved input unavailable instead of rendering an empty object' covers the drawer copy.
The diff adds no storage API, no fixture import, and no state hook holding submission data; buildPreservedInput is a pure function of the record prop, memoized on record identity only.
